turns.speaker: A
turns.text: We're staying at the Hotel Miramar.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: ¿Cuántas noches?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Four nights. Can I park my car there?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Mi hermana Lucía llega mañana en el tren de las diez.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Great, should I pick her up at the station?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I talked to Mark and David about the contract this morning.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: ¿Y qué dijo él?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Compré una mochila y una maleta en el mercado.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Nice. Is it big enough for the flight?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Is there somewhere I can buy painkillers?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Hay una farmacia en la esquina, al lado del banco.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Perfect, I'll go there after lunch.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Can you bring that one over here?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Oh no, I left my jacket in the restaurant.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: No te preocupes, yo la recojo mañana.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: My boss, Karen, wants the report by Friday.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Vale, sin problema.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: She also asked if you could translate the summary.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Mañana tengo reunión con la directora y con la abogada.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Ella quiere que lleves los documentos.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: We rented a little boat on the river yesterday.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: ¿Y pescasteis algo?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Not much, we mostly sat on the bank and talked.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Do you have cash for the taxi?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: No, tengo que pasar por el banco primero.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Mañana compro la vela.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Here we are. What do you recommend at this restaurant?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Déjame ver la carta primero.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: What are you doing tonight?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Tengo una cita a las siete.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: La máquina del parking solo acepta monedas.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Do you have any change?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: ¡Mira, allí arriba! ¿Lo ves?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Wait, was that a bat?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Mi hermano le va a pedir matrimonio a su novia el sábado.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: That's amazing! Has he bought the ring yet?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Where should I leave the documents?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Déjalos en el sobre.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: ¿Quién nos recoge en el aeropuerto?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Rose will meet us at the gate.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Bill said the invoice is ready.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Esta noche cenamos con Rosa y su marido.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: ¿Dónde aterrizáis?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: We land in Reading and then drive to Bath.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Who's your contact at the energy company?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Trabajo con Pilar Soto, de Iberdrola.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Ask Grace and Hope whether they want the window seats.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: ¿A qué hora sale el último autobús al centro?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: La dirección es un poco complicada.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Could you write it down for me?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: My flight is at six tomorrow morning.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Si quieres, te llevo al aeropuerto.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Can we move the meeting to three?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Vale, perfecto, a las tres.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Do you want to join us for dinner tonight?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Gracias, pero esta noche no puedo.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Tienes que hacer transbordo en Atocha y coger la línea uno.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Sorry, I don't understand. Change what?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The hotel was really nice, by the way.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Me alegro mucho.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: On a different note, did you finish the slides for Monday?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Call an ambulance right now, he's not breathing!

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Es urgente, necesito que firmes esto antes de las doce.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The flight got moved to the overnight one, so we land at dawn.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: ¿Cómo? No entiendo lo que dices.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I was wondering where the nearest cash machine is

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The reservation is for Thursday.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Vale, el jueves.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Sorry, no, I meant Tuesday, not Thursday.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: What time should we meet?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: A las cinco. Perdón, a las cinco no, a las seis.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: My room is 412.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: De acuerdo, la 412.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Wait, no, it's 421. Sorry.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: El museo está en la calle Alcalá.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Thanks, I'll walk there.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Ay, me equivoqué: está en la calle Atocha, no en Alcalá.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: ¿Es difícil el examen de conducir aquí?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Don't worry, it's a piece of cake.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Llevamos diez horas trabajando.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Let's call it a day, we can finish tomorrow.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Is it hard to set up the router?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: No te preocupes, eso es pan comido.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Mi jefe me tomó el pelo con lo del ascenso.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: ¿Cómo te aviso cuando llegue?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: My number is 07700 900123, text me when you land.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Mándame el billete a lucia.martin@example.com, por favor.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Para la reserva necesito su número de pasaporte y la tarjeta.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Sure, the passport is 533380006 and the card number is 4111 1111 1111 1111.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Good morning! How was your flight?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Muchas gracias por la cena, estaba todo buenísimo.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: ¿Soléis comer temprano?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: We usually have lunch around one o'clock.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: How many people are coming on Saturday?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Somos seis en total.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I'm almost ready, just give me ten minutes.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: ¿Qué tal la reunión?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Oh, great. Just great. Three hours to decide absolutely nothing.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Ana from accounting and my cousin Anna both arrive on Friday.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Vale, apuntado.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Anna needs a vegetarian meal.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I loved the museum this morning.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Sí, es precioso.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Changing the subject, are you hungry?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Un poco, la verdad.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Is that place expensive?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Llego el 3/4.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: March 4th?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: No, no, el tres de abril.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: ¿Qué tal el concierto?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: That gig was sick, the drummer totally killed it.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Por la mañana paseamos junto al río y luego tengo que cambiar dinero.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Okay, so let's meet at the bank at noon.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Ya hemos terminado el postre.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Bill, can you ask the waiter for the bill?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Aquí hacen la mejor paella de la ciudad.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I'm dying to try it.
